أنتظر (form VIII)
# أَنْتَظِرُ (ʔantaẓiru) /ʔan.ta.ðˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# أُنْتَظَرُ (ʔuntaẓaru) /ʔun.ta.ðˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# أَنْتَظِرَ (ʔantaẓira) /ʔan.ta.ðˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَظَرَ (intaẓara)
# أُنْتَظَرَ (ʔuntaẓara) /ʔun.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
